title: HELIX Govern: Data Quality Rule Library
description: A starter library of data quality rules organized by HELIX domain. Institutions adopt, adapt, and extend these rules for their context. Each rule includes a severity, a plain-language description, and a machine-testable expression.

rule_severity_definitions.critical: Data cannot be trusted for any purpose if this rule fails. Blocks downstream processing.
rule_severity_definitions.high: Data may produce incorrect reports or compliance filings. Requires remediation within 48 hours.
rule_severity_definitions.medium: Data is usable but quality is degraded. Should be remediated within one business cycle (term/month).
rule_severity_definitions.low: Cosmetic or enrichment issue. Address during routine maintenance.

rules.name: Student must have at least one identifier
rules.description: Every Student resource must have at least one entry in the identifiers array. A student without any identifier cannot be linked across systems.
rules.remediation: Check ERP source for missing ID assignment. Escalate to Registrar if no ID exists.

rules.name: Student status must be a valid HELIX code
rules.description: The status field must contain a value from the helix/student-status terminology.
rules.remediation: Review ERP-to-HELIX status mapping in Bridge. Unmapped codes must be resolved.

rules.name: Student name must have family and given name
rules.description: Every Student must have a non-empty family name and given name.
rules.expression: student.name.family IS NOT NULL AND student.name.given IS NOT NULL
rules.remediation: Check ERP person record. Some international students may have single-name conventions — document institutional policy for handling.

rules.name: Birth date must be reasonable
rules.description: Birth date must be between 100 years ago and 14 years ago (typical minimum enrollment age).
rules.remediation: Likely a data entry error. Review ERP source record.

rules.name: No duplicate helix_id
rules.description: Every Student resource must have a globally unique helix_id. Duplicates indicate a key generation or merge failure.
rules.remediation: Investigate UUID generation logic. Check for duplicate person records in ERP.

rules.name: Enrollment must reference a valid student
rules.description: student_ref must resolve to an existing Student resource.
rules.remediation: Student record may not have been loaded yet (sequencing issue) or PIDM/EmplID mapping failed.

rules.name: Enrollment must reference a valid academic period
rules.description: academic_period_ref must resolve to an existing AcademicPeriod resource.
rules.remediation: AcademicPeriod may not have been loaded. Load periods before enrollments.

rules.name: Completed enrollment must have a grade
rules.description: If enrollment_status is 'completed', the grade field must not be null.
rules.expression: IF enrollment.enrollment_status == 'completed' THEN enrollment.grade IS NOT NULL
rules.remediation: Grade may not have been posted yet in ERP, or transcript record is missing.

rules.name: Credit hours attempted must be positive
rules.description: credit_hours_attempted must be greater than zero for non-audit enrollments.
rules.remediation: Check course catalog credit hour assignment. Zero-credit courses should be flagged for review.

rules.name: Enrollment status must have valid census-date context
rules.description: An enrollment with status 'enrolled' should exist in a period where the census date has passed. Before census, status should be 'registered'.
rules.remediation: Review enrollment status transition logic in Bridge mapping. Pre-census records should use 'registered'.

rules.name: Dropped enrollment should have a drop date
rules.description: If enrollment_status is 'dropped' or 'withdrawn', drop_date should be populated.
rules.expression: IF enrollment.enrollment_status IN ('dropped', 'withdrawn') THEN enrollment.drop_date IS NOT NULL
rules.remediation: Check ERP registration audit trail for the drop/withdrawal date.

rules.name: Award amount must be non-negative
rules.description: amount_offered, amount_accepted, and amount_disbursed must all be >= 0.
rules.remediation: Negative amounts may indicate returns or adjustments. Model these as separate transactions or use a return flag.

rules.name: Disbursed amount cannot exceed accepted amount
rules.description: The amount disbursed should not exceed the amount the student accepted.
rules.remediation: Possible data timing issue (disbursement posted before acceptance update). Verify in ERP.

rules.name: Disbursed award must have a disbursement date
rules.description: If award_status is 'disbursed', disbursement_date must be populated.
rules.expression: IF fin_aid_award.award_status == 'disbursed' THEN fin_aid_award.disbursement_date IS NOT NULL
rules.remediation: Check ERP disbursement records for missing date.

rules.name: Award must reference a valid student
rules.description: student_ref must resolve to an existing Student resource.
rules.remediation: Student record may not have been loaded. Load students before financial aid.

rules.name: Award type must be a valid HELIX code
rules.description: award_type must contain a value from the helix/award-type terminology.
rules.remediation: Review ERP fund-to-HELIX award type mapping in Bridge.

rules.name: Course section must reference a valid course
rules.description: course_ref must resolve to an existing Course resource.
rules.remediation: Course catalog record may not have been loaded. Load courses before sections.

rules.name: Active course section must have valid schedule or delivery mode
rules.description: An active section should have either a schedule (days + times) or a delivery_mode of 'online_asynchronous'.
rules.expression: IF course_section.section_status == 'active' THEN (course_section.schedule IS NOT NULL OR course_section.delivery_mode == 'online_asynchronous')
rules.remediation: Schedule data may not have been mapped from ERP. Check Bridge mapping for meeting pattern extraction.

rules.name: Program must have a CIP code (US institutions)
rules.description: US institutions should have a CIP code on every degree-granting program for IPEDS reporting.
rules.expression: IF institution.country == 'US' AND program.program_type == 'major' THEN program.cip_code IS NOT NULL
rules.remediation: Check institutional program inventory against NCES CIP code database.

rules.name: Degree must reference a valid student and program
rules.description: student_ref and program_ref must resolve to existing resources.
rules.expression: EXISTS(Student WHERE helix_id = degree.student_ref) AND EXISTS(Program WHERE helix_id = degree.program_ref)
rules.remediation: Ensure student and program records are loaded before degree records.

rules.name: Conferral date must not be in the future
rules.description: A conferred degree should have a conferral_date on or before today.
rules.remediation: Future dates may indicate a projected conferral. Use Student.status='enrolled' until degree is actually conferred.

rules.name: Cumulative GPA must be in valid range
rules.description: If populated, cumulative_gpa should be between 0.0 and 4.0 (or institutional maximum).
rules.remediation: Some institutions use 5.0 or other scales. Adjust via Implementation Profile.
